menu_options.session: Sign in with a browser session (recommended)
menu_options.credentials: Sign in with email and password

session.title: Browser session
session.description: Sign in at myaccount.uw.co.uk, open your browser's developer tools, copy the `Cookie:` request header for that site, and paste it here. The session lasts about a month.

credentials.title: Utility Warehouse
credentials.description: Enter your Utility Warehouse account credentials to access energy usage, bills, and meter readings. Password sign-in does not currently work, because the portal requires a browser check that Home Assistant cannot complete — use a browser session instead.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh the Utility Warehouse session
reauth_confirm.description: The saved browser session for {account} has expired. Sign in again at myaccount.uw.co.uk and paste a fresh `Cookie:` header.

error.auth_error: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials.
error.connection_error: Could not connect to Utility Warehouse. Check your internet connection.

abort.reauth_successful: The Utility Warehouse session was updated.
